info.name: Wish Marketplace V3 Brands Orders API

params.name: dest_country_code
params.description: Country code of the country the order is being shipped to. For GENERAL order_type, leave this parameter blank. The 2-letter country codes are defined in [ISO 3166](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html).

params.name: order_type
params.description:
Choose the specific order type to get a list of approved carriers for. Current values include:
1. GENERAL: All accepted shipping carriers on Wish
2. CONFIRMED_DELIVERY: All accepted shipping carriers for Confirmed Delivery Policy. CONFIRMED_DELIVERY is a subset of the carrier list for GENERAL.

items.docs: Get a list of accepted shipping carriers based on order_type and dest_country_code. dest_country_code is only needed when order_type is not GENERAL.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit on the number of orders that will be returned.

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Specify the end of the time window to view orders by last order update. Orders updated after this time will not show.

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Specify the beginning of the window to view orders by last order update. Orders updated before this time will not show.

params.name: released_at_min
params.description: Specify the beginning of the time window to view desired orders when filtering by order release time. Orders released before this time will not show.

params.name: released_at_max
params.description: Specify the end of the time window to view desired orders when filtering by order release time. Orders released after this time will not show.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Choose which timestamp to filter orders by. Current values are:
* updated_at: Last time the order was updated.
* released_at: The time the order was released.

params.name: order_type
params.description:
Choose the specific programs to filter output orders by. Current input values are:
1. WISH_EXPRESS
2. FULFILLED_BY_WISH
3. FULFILLED_BY_STORE
4. LESS_THAN_TRUCKLOAD
5. ADVANCED_LOGISTICS
6. WISH_PLUS

Note: This parameter does not support combinations (ex: FULFILLED_BY_WISH & WISH_EXPRESS). If looking for overlaps, query these separately & then manually find the overlap, using Order ID.

params.name: states
params.description:
Choose the specific order state to filter output orders by. Current input values are:

1. APPROVED: Order ready to be shipped.
2. SHIPPED: Order has been shipped.
3. REFUNDED: Order has been refunded.
4. REQUIRE_REVIEW: Order has been placed under review
5. DECLINED: Customer's payment had an issue for this order

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the batch download job to query
